ns2:section.sectionText: Computational Optimization for Biological and Engineering Systems. This course provides a hands-on introduction to modern computational modeling and simulations techniques applied to the understanding of biophysical and engineering problems. From moving bodies in fluids and bio-hybrid robots, to unconventional ‘birds-nest’ materials and propulsion on sandy dunes, you will learn to model biophysical phenomena and implement software able to capture their essential behavior. Moreover, you will learn to employ evolutionary optimization algorithms in combination with the developed models, to inverse design more performant solutions. This course requires some basic Matlab or Python or C/C++ coding skills.
